summary: Lanvin Group Holdings Ltd disclosed that CFO Jiyang Han resigned effective May 31, 2026 for personal reasons, with no dispute with the company. Executive President Andy Lew has been appointed interim CFO effective May 7, 2026. The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by a foreign private issuer, akin to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.02. No financial terms or board recommendations are stated. The transition plan is structured to ensure continuity. Watch for permanent CFO appointment or any strategic moves by the luxury fashion group.
